name: Asylum
caption: Managed by Dr. Daniel Shinn, held the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Championship into the fed's last recovered broadcast before losing the belts to the debuting Beijing Beauties.

name: Beijing Beauties
caption: A trio managed by "Gorgeous" Gary Chung and styled identically to Ernie Chen, who debuted by winning the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Championship from Asylum on the fed's last recovered broadcast.
